_doc: Vectors of battery_chemistries. Expected values are the maker datasheet and Battery University numbers of the research file, in the unit of the column (V).

cells.ref: NiMH 1.2 V: Panasonic eneloop BK-3MCC datasheet
NiMH end-of-discharge 1.0 V per cell: Panasonic BK-3MCC (E.V. = 1.0 V) and Battery University BU-501
Energizer alkaline handbook: minimum cut-off 0.8 V per cell
Li-ion 4.20 V CC-CV: Panasonic NCR18650B, Samsung INR21700-50E and Battery University BU-205 agree
Li-ion discharge to 2.50 V: Panasonic NCR18650B, Samsung INR21700-50E and Battery University BU-205 agree
Lead-acid 1.75 V per cell: Yuasa NP7-12L (20 h rating) and Battery University BU-501 agree
Yuasa NP7-12L: cyclic charge 14.5 V per 12 V block = 2.42 V per cell
A123 ANR26650M1-B datasheet: 3.3 V nominal (Battery University BU-205: 3.20/3.30 V)
IEC 61960 positive-electrode letters (C, N, M, V, T) do not include F, so no letter is shown for LiFePO4
The Panasonic CR2032 datasheet states no discharge cut-off voltage, so the cell is left empty
IEC 60086 letter K for nickel-cadmium; Saft VRE AA 700 is designated KRMR 15/51
